summary: Cloudastructure filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Exchange Agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC partitioning a $63,332.50 tranche from an existing $1,299,870.00 promissory note dated June 30, 2026, and exchanging that partitioned note for 18,246 Class A shares. Streeterville paid no additional consideration; the partitioned note cancels on the Free Trading Date, reducing the note balance. Issued under Section 3(a)(9) exemption. Mechanics imply roughly $3.47 per share implied exchange value against debt, a debt-for-equity swap rather than a cash tender; watch dilution and note-balance runoff.
